name: m4-devirt-sym-prof3
description: Step 2 of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199) against its `owner` fix. The JIT pilot `m4-devirt-sym-jit` found that step 2's final `owner()` was 55 bytes of bytecode, over C2's MaxInlineSize, and refused as "too big" at 14-16 call sites. `8d581317e6` keeps its fast path at 31 bytes. PMU profile (cycles, instructions) through the kperf helper with `jitRecording`, scala corpus, one fork per build: stub attribution plus `jit_diff`. Not a timing A/B.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, as `m4-int00e3bb-kperf-l1d`.

variantDescriptions.fix: `8d581317e6`: step 2 with `owner`'s fast path cut to 31 bytes
